mapper.select: SELECT C.CONTENT_ID, C.TMDB_ID, C.CONTENT_TYPE, C.TITLE, C.POSTER_IMAGE_URL, C.SYNOPSIS, C.CREATED_AT, C.UPDATED_AT, G.GENRE_NAME FROM CONTENT C LEFT OUTER JOIN CONTENT_GENRES G ON C.CONTENT_ID = G.CONTENT_ID WHERE C.CONTENT_ID = #{id}
SELECT E.EPISODE_ID, E.EPISODE_NO, E.TITLE, E.SUMMARY, E.STILL_IMAGE_URL FROM CONTENT_EPISODE E WHERE E.CONTENT_ID = #{id} ORDER BY EPISODE_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTENT (TMDB_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, TITLE, POSTER_IMAGE_URL, SYNOPSIS) VALUES (#{tmdbId}, #{contentType}, #{title}, #{posterImageUrl}, #{synopsis})
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT SET TITLE = #{title}, POSTER_IMAGE_URL = #{posterImageUrl}, SYNOPSIS = #{synopsis}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TMDB_ID = #{tmdbId} AND CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTENT_PERSON (CONTENT_ID, NAME, CHAR_NAME, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{name}, #{charName}, #{profileImageUrl})
INSERT INTO CONTENT_EPISODE (CONTENT_ID, EPISODE_NO, TITLE, SUMMARY, STILL_IMAGE_URL) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{episodeNo}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{stillImageUrl})
